passages.title: Một ngày của Hoa
passages.bodyText: Hoa is a nurse at Bach Mai Hospital. She works from Monday to Friday. She gets up at six o'clock and starts work at seven. She has lunch at the hospital at half past eleven. She finishes work at four and picks up her son from school. On Saturday she doesn't work.

A: Excuse me, Ms Hoa. Do you have a minute?
B: Sure. What is it?
A: Can I take a day off on Friday?
B: On Friday? Why?
A: My sister is getting married.
B: OK, no problem. Who does your work on Friday?
A: Nam does. He knows my project.
